steps.name: Given the test logs are cleared for fresh start
Given this is a reverse transfer feature
log 📋 Reverse transfer feature initialized with fresh log file
Given the user is logged in and navigates to the transfer page
And the user navigates to the transfer page and clicks on "Add Transfer" button
When the user selects source type as "Company" from dropdown
When the user checks Company Account balance
task writeLog, 💰 Company Account Balance: BHD 50.000
When the user calculates reverse transfer amount keeping 50 BHD reserve
log ⚠️ Company balance (50) <= reserve (50), cannot transfer
task writeLog, ⚠️ Company balance 50 <= reserve 50, skipping reverse transfer
When the user selects the target as "Flexi" from dropdown
log 💰 Flexi Target Balance: BHD NaN
When the user should see the target as "Flexi"
When the user enters calculated reverse amount
log ⚠️ Skipping transfer entry - reverse amount is 0
When the user fills the description of the transfer as 'Reverse Transfer to Flexi'
When the user captures transfer summary
log Source Box Text: Company - BHD 50.000Current balanceBHD 50.000- 0.000New balanceBHD 50.000
log Target Box Text: Flexi AccountCurrent balanceBHD 0.000+ 0.000New balanceBHD -NaN
